audit_items.proof_trace: All admin-designated server actions (updateMemberAdmin, toggleAdminStatus, deleteMember, updateMemberTeams, syncAllDiscordRoles, updateStatusesForNewAcademicYear, renameGraduatesToNewFormat, all team CRUD, all generation CRUD, OAuth client POST/DELETE) independently verify is_admin=true via a fresh DB query against members.is_admin before proceeding. The checkAdmin() helper calls supabase.auth.getUser() (validated server-side by Supabase) then queries the members table each call, so admin revocation is immediately effective. The sole exported action without an admin check (ensureGenerationRoleExists) is intentionally callable from non-admin member self-registration and is not an admin-only action by design.
